translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: Filipenses
book.title: Filiposgi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Garda Narmaksad Filipenses

content: Gwenadgan, Bab-Jesúsgi wergudigu be gumar

Degisoggu gwenadgan, na nue-be-sabmalad, degi, nue na-be-dakbimarbalid, ar ade bemar weligwar an-imakmalad, degine, bemar an-olo-gurginyob gumalad. Wegibi bemar Bab-Jesúsgi gandik gudigu-imakmalo. Gwenadgan, an na nue-be-sabmalad.
Emigindi omegan-warbogwadse wilesakwaa an goled, Evodia, degi, Síntiquese. Bemardi na be igar-nabomar, Bab-Jesúsba-naid-ular, na emarbi be binsamar.

Deginbali, bedina, anba-be-nue-arbadiid, we-bunmar wis be bendako, adi na emarbi binsamalagar. We-bunmar, degi, Clemente, degi, baiganmo, anba nue arbananai-gusmogad, Bab-Jesúsgi abonolegedgi an sunmakdigusgu. Amar-nug garda-burba-geg-berguedgi bato narmakar naimogad.
Bab-Jesúsgi wergudigu be gumar. Gannar an bemarga sogbalid, be wergumarye.
Bitigi bela dulemar be-daksamalana-gadin, bemar sabedgi ibmar-imaked-dulemarye. Bab-Jesús-gannar-danikiddi nue warmakdanikid.
Mer surbinsa be itomar, Bab-Dummadse-goledgi bela ega ibmar be sogmar. Ibmar-na-be-abediidi Bab Dummadse be egis, degi, ega dog-nuedye be sogmarbar bega ibmar ukdiidbar.

Geb degi ulubgi-bogidik-itoleged Bab Dummad bemarga ukoed. We ulubgi-bogidik-itoleged dummarbasoggu, dulemar nue aku itoged. We ulubgi-bogidik-itoleged, bemar-gwagegi, degi, bemar-binsaedgi bemar nikunonikoed, ar Cristo-Jesúsgi bemar bensulidba.
Ibmar-nueganginbi be binsamar

Gwenadgan, an bemarga napi sogmar, unnila igar-napiragwadgi be binsamar, bela nug-nued-nikuedgi, bela igar-inikigwadgi, bela ibmar-swilidikidgi, bela yeer-itole dule-imakedgi, degi, bela ibmar-nued-egi-soglediidgi, aginbi bemar binsamar. Degine, igid igar-nued mamaidgi, degi, egi nabir-nug-odummolegedgi, amargi bemar binsamarsun.
Ar igi angi be durdaksamala, angi be abingasmala, angi be itosmala, degi, be an-daksamarbali, aba bemar damarsun. Deyob bemar gudiile, Bab Dummad ulubgi-bogidik-itoleged uked, bemarba gudiguoed.
Filipos-dorgan Pabloga mani wesa-gusmalad
Ibibayobi Bab-Jesúsgi weligwar an itoge, ar ade bemar geb angi gannar binsaarbargu. An sogsurdo, bemar an ies-gudiiye. Suli, unnila an-bendakega bemar geg-gue gusmalad.
An we bemarga-ibmar-sogedi, an ibmar-abegedba bemarga sogsulid. Ar bato an durdas-gudiid, ar an ibmar nika-dibe, ibmar niksurbar-dibe, an gusgu weligwar ito-daed.

An wisi igi wilesakwaa nanalege, degi, an wisbalid, ibmar-ichesur-nikadgi igi nanalebali. Bato an durdaksad, igi an nanaoe ibmar ise-obinagwar an nikar, degi, ibmar ise-akuedgi an nikbalir, igi an nanabaloe. An ise-immedikidgin-dibe, ise-ukumadadgin-dibe, agi wergued an durdaksad.
Ar Cristogi bela sunna an ibmar saed, e-gangued anga ukedba.
Degi-inigwele, ar bemar nued imaksamarbardo, an-nunmakedyob na be anba itononimarmogu.

Bemar Filipos-dorgan, na be nue wismalad, an Macedonia-akar-nadgu, gebe Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nuedgi an sunmakdegu, unnila bemarbi anga mani barmiar-gusmalad, Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad-baigandi anga gwen mani barmiar-gussurmalad.
Amba an Tesalónicagi maigu, bemar an-bendakega irbigbasaar mani barmiar-gusmalad.
Bemargi mani-gaedgi an binsasulid, an binsaed, bemar ibmar-nued imaked, Bab-Dummad-asabin bemarga urbilemai-guegar.

Ar ibmar unniguar bato an nikad, obinegwagi an abingasad. Ar bemar Epafroditoba anga ibmar barmiarmarsoggu, emigindi bato unniguar an niksundo. Epafroditoba-bemar-anga-ibmar-barmialiddi Bab Dummad nue-yeer abingasad, ibmar-wawadikid gummakar ega uklegedyobi abingasad.
Degisoggu, an-Bab-Dummad na bela be ibmar abedimalad, Cristo-Jesúsgi bemarga ukoed, na nibneggi unnitiba ibmar-nika-maidba.
Bab Dummad anmar-Baba, a e-nugdi odummolesun, degi-sadegu gusun. ¡Ar deyobdo!
Cristo-Jesúsgi-akananaimaladga anga be sogo, andi nued gudiiye. Gwenadgan-anba-gudimalad bemarga sogsimarmogad, emarde nued gudimarye.
Bela wegi Jesucristogi-akananaimalad, Roma-Dummad-César-neggi-bukmalad, amar bur-bule bemarga sogmalad, emarde nued gudimarye.
Anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo, bela bitigi bemargi nued binsaena-gadin. Be itomargua.
